snippet.textDisplay: A single software bug in JPMorgan Chase’s on-premise hardware doesn't just slow Chase. it cascades into Zelle and counterparty transfers across Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and U.S. Bank. When payment rails concentrate around the largest clearing banks, a localized technical glitch quickly looks like a broader liquidity freeze to anyone checking a balance or trying to move cash. That's the structural risk worth watching behind the headlines.
